salon.title: Rue au Lin, right in the centre of Amiens
salon.text: Hair Évasion is a city-centre salon where we take our time. We listen first, look at the shape of your face, the texture of your hair, how you style it in the morning. Only then do we suggest a cut or a colour.

portrait.title: A careful look before the scissors
portrait.text: Face-shape styling means choosing the length, volume and tones that bring out your features. No one-size-fits-all cut, no trend pasted onto everyone.

space.title: Time for yourself
space.text: An unhurried shampoo, a scalp massage, a coffee: the salon is made for slowing down.

products.title: Care that respects your hair
products.text: At the basin and in the shop, we work with Leonor Greyl natural hair care and L’Oréal Professionnel. For colour, plant-based colour is available if you want something gentler.

tips.title: Between appointments
tips.lead: A few simple habits to make your cut and colour last.

items.title: Keeping balayage bright
items.text: A gentle sulphate-free shampoo, a mask once a week and lukewarm rather than hot water. A gloss at the salon every 6 to 8 weeks revives the tones.

items.title: After colouring
items.text: Wait 48 hours before the first wash so the colour can set, and protect your hair from sun and chlorine.

items.title: How often to cut
items.text: Every 6 weeks for a short cut or a bob, every 8 to 10 weeks for long hair: the ends stay neat and the shape holds.

items.title: Blow-drying and heat
items.text: Always use a heat protectant and keep straighteners below 180 °C. Letting your hair air-dry now and then does the lengths good.

gift.title: Give time at the salon
gift.text: A gift voucher for a cut, a colour, a treatment or any amount you like, tucked into a pretty box with the products they already love. Prepared at the salon, just give us a call.

infos.title: Getting to the salon
infos.accessText: Right in the town centre, a few minutes' walk from Place Gambetta and the cathedral. Leave a little extra time to park: city-centre car parks fill up quickly on Saturdays.

balayage.metaTitle: Balayage in Amiens: blonde, caramel, ombré | Hair Évasion
balayage.metaDescription: Balayage, highlights, ombré and tie and dye in central Amiens. Hand-painted tones chosen for your face and skin tone, at Hair Évasion, 4 rue au Lin.
balayage.title: Balayage in Amiens
balayage.intro: Good balayage doesn’t look like colour: it looks like your hair has caught the sun. At Hair Évasion, tones are painted by hand, section by section, to suit your face, your skin tone and your natural base.

sections.title: Blonde, caramel, copper
sections.text: Bright blonde on fair hair, caramel or honey on light brown, copper tones to warm up dark hair: we choose together the shade that lights up your face, without a harsh regrowth line.

sections.title: Balayage, highlights or ombré?
sections.text: Balayage gives soft, blended tones painted freehand. Highlights lighten more evenly, from root to tip. Ombré and tie and dye play on a gradient, darker at the top, lighter at the ends. We advise you depending on how much upkeep you want.

sections.title: How long, how much upkeep?
sections.text: Usually 2 to 3 hours at the salon. Balayage grows out softly: a refresh every 3 to 4 months is enough, with a gloss in between to keep it bright.

balayage.related: See also plant-based colour and Japanese straightening on the salon menu.

mariage.metaDescription: Bridal hair in Amiens: trial, updos, braids, waves, accessories. Hair Évasion also styles bridesmaids, mothers and children. 4 rue au Lin.
mariage.title: Wedding hair in Amiens
mariage.intro: Your hair should feel like you, go with the dress, and survive the hugs and the dance floor. We plan it with you, from the first idea to the trial, then on the day.

steps.title: First meeting
steps.text: Bring your photos, the dress, the veil or accessories. We talk about the day’s schedule, your hair and what you love.

steps.title: The trial
steps.text: A few weeks before the wedding, we do the full style. We adjust until it’s exactly what you pictured.

steps.title: The day
steps.text: We style you and your loved ones, calmly and on time. The style is built to last until the end of the evening.

styles.title: Updos, braids, waves
styles.text: Low braided bun, high bun with jewellery, loose waves, half-up with flowers, boho braid: every photo on this page was styled by the salon.

guests.title: Bridesmaids, mothers, children
guests.text: The salon also styles your circle: bridesmaid updos, sets, little flowered styles for flower girls.
